### Review Report

## Review Summary

### Findings
- [Missing prerequisite] Medium: `tasks/main.yml` - `memcached.yml` was never included, so the role did not install or configure Memcached despite migrating the Memcached recipe - Fixed.
- [Missing prerequisite] Medium: `tasks/memcached.yml: Create Memcached log directory` and `Create Memcached runtime directory` - The configured Memcached user and group were referenced without being explicitly created by the role - Fixed by adding service group and user tasks before directory creation.
- [Missing package dependency] Low: `tasks/main.yml: Remove obsolete Redis replication directives` - The task depends on Redis configuration being generated by the delegated Redis role; execution order was correct, but the Memcached tasks were previously omitted from the main flow - Fixed by including Memcached before Redis configuration.
- [Configuration completeness] Low: `tasks/memcached.yml: Configure Memcached options` - Several migrated settings (`memcached_max_object_size`, `memcached_experimental_options`, and `memcached_extra_cli_options`) were defined but not applied - Fixed by adding them to the generated options line.

### Changes Made
- `tasks/main.yml`: Added inclusion of `memcached.yml` before Redis configuration.
- `tasks/memcached.yml`: Added explicit Memcached service group and user creation.
- `tasks/memcached.yml`: Applied the migrated maximum object size and additional CLI options.
- Confirmed package installation precedes configuration and service startup.
- Confirmed handlers use valid service names and configuration changes notify the appropriate restart handlers.
- Confirmed no unguarded `command` or `shell` tasks are present.
- Confirmed `meta/argument_specs.yml` exists and covers the role defaults plus the required Redis credential variable.

### No Issues Found
- Idempotency failures
- Invalid module parameters
- Ordering issues after fixes
- Missing directories for role-managed paths
- Missing owning application packages for changed files and managed services
